call 调工具，send 发送，wait/observe 等待，if 分支，p: call invokes a tool; send sends a message; wait/observe waits; if branches; parallel runs independent read-only calls; yield returns control to the model.
须先成功的步骤 ID。: IDs of steps that must succeed first.
失败后继续、返回模型、执行 fallback 或停止分支；uncertain 表: After failure, continue, return to the model, run fallback, or stop the branch. uncertain means the outcome is unknown; verify before deciding whether to retry.
社交参与入口。用 {\"reply\":\"正文\"} 发送回复，普通文字不会发: Social participation entry point. Send a reply with {"reply":"message"}; plain text is not sent. steps sequences tool calls and messages; query results return to the current model. Treat only confirmed deliveries as sent and avoid duplicate sends.
reply 回复；pass 不参与；wait 等对方补充；observe 关注后: reply responds; pass declines participation; wait awaits more information; observe watches subsequent messages; defer reconsiders later; continue proceeds with processing.
auto 默认发送后结束、查询后继续；end 结束；continue 继续判断。: auto ends after sending and continues after queries by default; end finishes; continue returns to model reasoning.
相关新消息到来时：reconsider 默认重新判断，keep 保留计划，can: When a relevant new message arrives: reconsider re-evaluates by default, keep retains the plan, and cancel cancels unexecuted steps.
后续关注事项，不向会话发送。: Items to follow up on; not sent to the conversation.
不参与或等待的简短理由，不向会话发送。: Brief reason for declining or waiting; not sent to the conversation.
发送后继续等待、观察或延后。: Continue waiting, observing, or deferring after sending.
前序结果路径，如 lookup.data.user_id。: Path in an earlier result, such as lookup.data.user_id.
关注的平台账号 ID；省略或为空时关注当前对话对象或提及你的消息。: Platform account IDs to watch. If omitted or empty, watch messages from the current conversation partner or mentions of you.
匹配任一事件：new_message 新消息、mention_me 提及你、im: Match any event: new_message for new messages, mention_me for mentions of you, or image for images. Defaults to new_message.
观察有效期（秒）；同级操作的 expires_in_seconds 优先。: Observation lifetime in seconds. The enclosing operation's expires_in_seconds takes precedence.
发送正文；content 与 attachments 至少提供一项。: Message text. Provide at least one of content or attachments.
资源链接、工作区路径或 attachment:附件ID，也可引用前序结果。: Resource URL, workspace path, or attachment:attachmentID. An earlier result may also be referenced.
本次计划内唯一的步骤 ID；引用结果或声明依赖时填写，省略则自动编号。: Step ID unique within this plan. Set it when referencing results or declaring dependencies; omitted IDs are assigned automatically.
call 参数；social 等工具用 {action,input}，与步骤外层: call arguments. Social tools use {action,input}; choose this or the step's outer action/input fields. Current-conversation queries may omit conversation IDs. Use {$ref:"stepID.data.field"} to reference earlier results.
Wait duration in milliseconds, default 5000. For observe, set the duration using watch.expires_in_seconds.
只读调用的额外重试次数，默认 1；写操作不重试。: Additional retries for read-only calls, default 1. Write operations are not retried.
被判断的前序结果路径，如 lookup.data.found。: Earlier result path to evaluate, such as lookup.data.found.
exists 已有该值；truthy 为真；eq 等于 value；ne 不等于: exists checks that a value exists; truthy checks truthiness; eq compares equality with value; ne compares inequality.
eq/ne 使用的比较值，可为任意 JSON 值。: Comparison value for eq/ne; accepts any JSON value.
parallel 的子步骤，格式同外层，仅填写独立只读 call，不填写 dep: Child steps for parallel, using the outer step format. Only independent read-only calls are allowed; omit depends_on and fallback.
if 条件成立时执行的步骤，格式同外层。: Steps to run when the if condition is true, using the outer step format.
if 条件不成立时执行的步骤，格式同外层。: Steps to run when the if condition is false, using the outer step format.
on_error=fallback 时执行的备用步骤，格式同外层。: Fallback steps to run for on_error=fallback, using the outer step format.
默认 reply 回复；pass 不参与，不能同时发送或填写 steps；wai: Defaults to reply. pass declines participation and cannot include messages or steps; wait awaits more information; observe watches later messages; defer reconsiders later; continue proceeds with processing.
单条回复正文；引用、提及和附件使用同级 quote、mentions、attac: Single reply text. Set quoting, mentions, and attachments with the sibling quote, mentions, and attachments fields.
依次发送的多段消息，每段分别设置正文、引用、提及、附件或延迟。: Messages to send in sequence, each with its own text, quote, mentions, attachments, or delay.
按顺序执行，先于 reply/messages；含分支共最多 48 步，嵌套最多: Run in sequence before reply/messages. Up to 48 steps including branches, with up to 4 levels of nesting.
默认 auto：含工具调用时返回模型，仅发送则结束；end 结束；continu: Defaults to auto: return to the model if tool calls are included; finish for sends only. end finishes; continue returns to the model.
reply 发送前或 wait/defer 的等待毫秒数；默认分别为 0、500: Milliseconds before a reply or for wait/defer. Defaults are 0, 5000, and 300000 respectively.
等待或观察有效期（秒）；默认 300，defer 默认 3600；省略时可沿用: Wait or observation lifetime in seconds. Defaults to 300, or 3600 for defer. If omitted, the watch setting may be used.
wait/defer 的等待毫秒数，默认分别为 5000、300000。: Wait/defer duration in milliseconds, default 5000 and 300000 respectively.
默认 auto；action=continue 时默认 continue。aut: Defaults to auto, or continue when action=continue. auto returns to the model if tool calls are included and finishes for sends only; end finishes; continue returns to the model.
默认 continue 继续后续步骤；return_to_model 返回模型；: Defaults to continue with subsequent steps; return_to_model returns control to the model; fallback runs fallback steps; stop_branch stops the current branch. Verify uncertain outcomes before deciding whether to retry.
